name: quarter
description: Calendar quarter of the report, 1 to 4

name: report_date
description: Last calendar day of the reporting quarter

name: rssd_id
description: RSSD identifier assigned by the Federal Reserve, unique per institution and stable across name and charter changes; the join key across every table in this dataset. To reach us_fdic_bankfind, join through institution.fdic_cert_id, which carries the FDIC certificate

name: fdic_cert_id
description: FDIC certificate number, the institution key used by us_fdic_bankfind
observations: Reported as 0 when the institution has no FDIC certificate; converted to NULL.

name: occ_charter_id
description: OCC charter number for nationally chartered banks
observations: Reported as 0 when not OCC chartered; converted to NULL.

name: ots_docket_id
description: Former OTS docket number for thrift institutions
observations: Reported as 0 when absent; converted to NULL.

name: aba_routing_id
observations: Reported as 0 when absent; converted to NULL.

name: name
description: Legal name of the financial institution

name: address
description: Street address of the institution's main office

name: city
description: City of the institution's main office

name: state_abbreviation
description: Two-letter postal abbreviation of the state of the main office
observations: Not linked to the state directory: its primary key is the FIPS code, and the abbreviation is a non-key column.

name: zip_code
description: ZIP code of the institution's main office

name: call_report_form_id
description: Call Report form the institution filed for the quarter

name: last_submission_updated_at
description: Timestamp at which the institution last updated its submission for the quarter
observations: Later than the report date, and moves when an amended filing is accepted.
